title: Cinematic Dream Weaver
description: A green-skinned woman in a red patterned dress stands barefoot on a crumbling staircase, one arm raised as film strips, movie reels, and framed pictures float around her. The ceiling is torn open revealing a surreal apocalyptic cityscape at sunset with ruined towers under a purple and orange sky, while a film projector in the foreground casts a beam of light.
prompt: A surreal scene of a green-skinned woman with long dark hair wearing a flowing red patterned dress, standing barefoot on a broken stone staircase inside a decaying room. She reaches upward as film strips, movie reels, and framed pictures float around her. The ceiling is ripped open exposing a dystopian ruined city skyline against a dramatic purple and orange sunset. A vintage film projector sits in the foreground casting a beam of light, cinematic surrealism, detailed digital painting.
